initialization.semantics: frozen completion only; new TAM, optimizer, RNG, history and elapsed budget

calibration.scope: T_core after TCM, before any TAM update; train/dropout TAM, eval frozen TCM; no_grad

grouping.scope: connected-component closure of same selected pair decisions; no fusion model run

train_eval_scale_observation.scope: FP32 cached eval scores replayed in float64; equal class weights and training margin. Different train/V populations and modes; does not isolate dropout or establish a code bug.

old020.limitation: aggregate only; no paired score/AUC verification
